name: Railway
description: Deploy projects to Railway directly from Teros workspaces. Supports automatic deployments, environment management, and database provisioning. Accepts both workspace-scoped tokens (full account access) and project-scoped tokens (restricted to a single project — some list operations will return empty by design).

RAILWAY_TOKEN.description: Railway API token. Two flavours: **Account/Workspace token** (full access to all projects in the workspace) or **Project token** (scoped to a single project). Get yours at https://railway.app/account/tokens (account/workspace) or Project → Settings → Tokens (project-scoped).

scopes.label: Account / Workspace token
scopes.notes: Full access. railway-list-projects and railway-list-workspaces return data.

scopes.label: Project-scoped token
scopes.notes: Restricted to a single project. railway-list-projects will return empty — use railway-get-project with the project ID directly.
